parameters.name: DeleteAlarmRulesBeforeUpdate
parameters.description: Specifies whether to delete existing alert rules before applying the alert template. Default value: false.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description to be updated for the application.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Set the value to cn-hangzhou.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos update-application --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name My-Application --description test_application --tags k1=v1 k2=v2 --alarm-config '{"ContactGroups":["云账号报警联系人"],"HealthCheckUrl":"/healthcheck/tcp50122","TemplateIds":["d8d1153c517f4971a37350ba8c021c26"]}' --delete-alarm-rules-before-update false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos UpdateApplication --region cn-hangzhou --Description test_application --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Tags '{"k1":"v1","k2":"v2"}' --DeleteAlarmRulesBeforeUpdate false --Name 'My-Application' --AlarmConfig '{"ContactGroups":["云账号报警联系人"],"HealthCheckUrl":"/healthcheck/tcp50122","TemplateIds":["d8d1153c517f4971a37350ba8c021c26"]}'
